📦 **Sculpture `746e6a5`** — docs(tidegrave): verify and accept frozen skeleton and shell stages

Read the original four skeleton events through 230136_710_bc4cb9.json;
replay matches all 118405 design cells and colors. Face components 1,
closed cavities 0, mirrored cell/color differences 0. Current raster pixels
and RGB colors match the design; the PNG probe reads 0 before and 3 after
translating the entire replayed asset by three cells.

Record sources, event hashes, the readonly rerun command, construction images,
the later validation journal, and the boundary between early stage acceptance
and the final assembled ship. No sculpture state or shared game source changed.

The same replay checks the initial shell and port cuts. Clarify TASK-0544's
self-authored conflicting criterion: shell additions preserve the skeleton;
the planned 48 port cuts must exactly match their declared design, with every
other cell and color preserved. Keep all four acceptance items and record why.
An additional readonly check rebuilds the 6480-cell cut set from the hull law,
checks all 48 port cross-sections, and rejects one extra or omitted cut.
Skeleton 118405, shell addition 549603, initial combined 668008, after ports
661528. Each stage has 1 component, 0 cavities and 0 mirror differences;
the exterior-water flood does not reach the interior probe.
Full ship regeneration and manual cloth acceptance are outside this closure.

Fixes TASK-0543
Fixes TASK-0544
Refs TASK-0540
